answers.text: Water shortages made farming difficult. Communities had to find ways to grow crops while using less water.
Drip irrigation directed small amounts of water close to plant roots, reducing waste compared with some traditional irrigation methods.
Israeli engineers, farmers and businesses worked together to improve and spread these technologies.
These systems helped farmers manage water more precisely and became useful in many countries. We would compare evidence about cost and water savings.
We think cooperation, practical problem solving and persistence helped make innovation possible. We should also investigate the limits of any solution.
